title: Predator and Prey
description: More prey feed more predators, more predators eat more prey, and so it cycles, round and round. Unlocks Stable Ecosystems and the Symbiont Lining.

puzzle.goal: Prey settle at the level where predators neither grow nor shrink: predator death g against gain d per prey. Write that prey level X.
puzzle.name: Fixed point
puzzle.ask: Find X for g = @{g}, k = @{k} and m = 0.
puzzle.method: Predators hold steady when gain k.x equals death g, so the prey sit at g/k, plus any steady immigration m.
